> IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter at Nirma University, Ahmedabad, India.
> We run technical events, hackathons, CTF competitions, workshops, and research programs for undergraduate engineering students.

### Hire Your Research Agent (COMPLETED)
- Type: Workshop
- Date: April 5, 2026
- Duration: 1 day
- Description: A hands-on workshop on building autonomous research agents using large language models and agentic frameworks. Participants built AI-powered pipelines that browse the web, summarize papers, and generate structured research reports — no prior ML experience required.

### Future of AI (COMPLETED)
- Type: Masterclass
- Date: April 2, 2026
- Duration: 1 day
- Description: IEEE Computer Society at Nirma University presented a masterclass on the AI revolution featuring Naren Kachroo, Head of Sales, AI at Google Cloud India, bridging the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world impact.

## Achievements & Milestones

### 1st Place — HackDays Ahmedabad 2025
- Date: 2025-10-15
- Description: Secured 1st place in the regional 24-hour hackathon by developing an automated agentic AI pipeline for legal document verification and smart risk analysis.
- Contributors: Deep Joshi, Priyansh Patel, Aarav Mehta

### IEEE CS Outstanding Student Branch Chapter Award
- Date: 2025-08-10
- Description: Recognized by IEEE Computer Society India Council for exceptional technical programming, student engagement, and open-source contributions across Gujarat.
- Contributors: Dr Umesh Bodhke, Deep Joshi, Vedanshi Bhatt, Divy Shah

### Top 3 Finish — National Cybersecurity CTF 2025
- Date: 2025-05-20
- Description: Outperformed 120+ university teams in a 36-hour Jeopardy CTF competition covering Web Exploitation, Cryptography, Reverse Engineering, and Binary Forensics.
- Contributors: Priyansh Patel, Ridham Shah, Rohan Sharma

### Chapter Open Source Sprint — 50+ PRs Merged
- Date: 2025-03-12
- Description: Led a month-long community sprint guiding 80+ students to make high-impact open-source contributions to developer tools and security libraries.
- Contributors: Deep Joshi, Ridham Shah, Meet Patel

### Best Technical Workshop Series Award 2024
- Date: 2024-11-05
- Description: Conducted hands-on sessions on Agentic AI, LLM Fine-Tuning, and Distributed Systems, training over 350+ engineering students across 4 sessions.
- Contributors: Franky Patel, Sakshi Chavda, Mahi Acharya

### Published Research Paper at IEEE CONECCT 2024
- Date: 2024-07-18
- Description: Co-authored and presented research on lightweight cryptographic verification for decentralized edge nodes.
- Contributors: Dr Umesh Bodhke, Deep Joshi, Palak Sinojia

### Excellence in Digital Outreach & Design 2024
- Date: 2024-04-14
- Description: Awarded for designing high-impact visual identity and marketing campaigns for chapter tech events, reaching 10,000+ students across Gujarat.
- Contributors: Vishwa Ghori, Keya Jeni, Pari Pancholi, Neha Siju

## Technology Stack

- Static Site: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript
- Dynamic Data Engine: Runtime JSON assets under `/data/` (`events.json`, `team.json`, `gallery.json`, `achievements.json`, `meta.json`)
- Hosted: GitHub Pages
